title: The IEG Field Manual
formalTitle: The Identity and Execution Governance Field Manual
subtitle: Identity and Execution Governance for Autonomous Systems
taglineSecondary: AI Security, Protected Actions, and Countermeasures
author: Maurice Witten
thesis: AI systems do not fail loudly. They fail quietly, and still act.
thesisSupporting: The public practitioner field manual for identifying, containing, governing, remediating, reversing, and proving failures across the AI execution stack.
supportingStatement: The public field manual for governing consequential execution across AI agents, machine identities, software systems, tools, models, workflows, and infrastructure.
categoryExplanation: Authentication establishes identity. Access control determines which systems an identity may reach. Identity and Execution Governance determines which consequences a human, AI agent, machine identity, software system, or autonomous workflow may cause, under whose authority, under what conditions, and with what proof.
operatingModel: Free doctrine. Open knowledge. Paid enforcement.
boundaryStatement: The doctrine is public. Production assessment, integration, enforcement, evidence operations, and enterprise support are delivered by BlockSiFr.
governingRules: If it can execute, it can be exploited.
If it cannot be proven, it cannot be governed.
